## Type of change

- [ ] Specification or documentation (`src/content/`)
- [ ] Website code

## For specification changes

- Agreed in issue: #
- [ ] It uses the terms in the specification's vocabulary (section 1.1)
- [ ] New claims are sourced or labelled as hypotheses

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No confidential company information, customer data or personal data
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (code changes only)
